mechanics.description_raw:
Increases ATK by 12%.
Casting Intro Skill or hitting the target with Basic Attack
increases the wielder's Basic Attack DMG by
36% for 4s. Each time the wielder
inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting
during Basic Attacks, all DMG dealt by Resonators in the
team is increased by 8% for 30s,
up to 3 stacks. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
